result.title: SketchForge: Training-Free Scene-to-Vector Sketching via Decoupled Structure and Texture Optimization
result.summary: Converting a raster image into a resolution-independent, stroke-editable vector sketch while faithfully preserving both structural contours and tonal texture remains challenging: raster-space rendering pipelines are difficult to edit at the stroke level, while generation-from-scratch vectorization methods struggle to remain faithful to an arbitrary input image. We present SketchForge, a training-free framework that converts an input raster image into a resolution-independent SVG sketch through per-instance test-time optimization of Bezier curves, requiring no additional training or fine-tuning. Strokes are seeded via a contour and attention-guided initialization, then refined by a vector-native differentiable rendering pipeline that decouples structural contour strokes from free-form texture strokes under dedicated objectives, composited via multiply-blend layering. Extensive experiments show that SketchForge consistently outperforms existing vector-based baselines in structural fidelity and generation quality. Project page: https://khangcntn123.github.io/SketchForge

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练框架 SketchForge，通过逐实例测试时优化 Bezier 曲线，把栅格图像转成分辨率无关、可编辑的 SVG 草图，并用解耦的结构轮廓与自由纹理笔画目标配合可微矢量渲染进行精修。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是图像到矢量图形的可编辑化生成，输出为笔画参数而非模型内部推理状态，也未涉及视觉证据保留、latent 内容被答案使用或停止决策，逐实例测试时优化虽属优化式生成但缺少与 LVR 问题的具体联系，故排除。
